why: I checked all eight expect lines against both must_not items. Item 1 (a check only possible after merge): every expect line can be checked at the PR head with `npm ci`, the CLI, `npm test` or a README read. Publishing to npm is explicitly a non-goal ("Publishing the package to npm or wiring it into the ccp_machine harness"), so no line depends on a release. Item 2 (lines that a tool without npm-test tests would still satisfy): one expect line says "Root `npm test` exits 0 and runs a node:test suite for the jsonl-lint workspace that reports at least one passing test". Its proof greps for the workspace test script line and for `# pass [1-9]`. A tool with no tests run by `npm test` would therefore fail that line. Neither forbidden item appears.
